title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Sunrise Musical Theatre, Sunrise | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Sunrise Musical Theatre in Sunrise, Florida, USA, on 27 March 1999.

It was the penultimate show by the fifth All-Starr Band. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Starr had previously performed at the Sunrise Musical Theatre on 2 and 3 June 1992, 4 and 5 August 1995, and 17 May 1997. He returned there on 3 June 2000.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
